summary: The audit counts 20 letter-graded units of Aero/Astro courses numbered 200 and above, leaving out seminars, research and thesis units. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA on those courses, the Director of Graduate Studies' approval of your program, and that your reading and oral committees each include an Aero/Astro faculty member.

add.why: "completing 20 units of graded, graduate-level courses in the Aero/Astro Department ... Seminars and independent study (research) units do not count toward the required 20 units." Graduate-level is read as numbered 200 and above, the way the department's M.S. text treats a 100-level course as an exception among graduate-level courses. Excluded: the AA seminars (289, 296, 299), Problems in Aero/Astro (290, 290S) and thesis units (300, 301, 801, 802).

node.name: 20 units of graded graduate-level Aero/Astro courses

add.why: "A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 on these courses is required to fulfill the Ph.D. minor."

node.name: GPA of 3.0 on the minor courses

add.why: "following a program (and performance) approved by the department’s Director of Graduate Studies"

node.name: Program approved by the Director of Graduate Studies

add.why: "The student’s Ph.D. Reading Committee and University Oral Committee must each include at least one faculty member from Aero/Astro."

node.name: An Aero/Astro faculty member on your reading committee and on your oral committee
